FN-NRVMBJJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 435
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Cindy Myrex
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/17/2026
House Bill 435 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund by $15, and the
Alabama Housing Foundation by $5, for each application for certificate of title for
manufactured homes designated 1999 or prior.
In addition, this bill could also increase receipts to the appropriate issuing official by up to $3
for each application processed.
Page 1
